steps.thought: List all available tests to understand the station capabilities and determine the cheapest tests to run first.

tests.name: power_on_selftest
tests.description: Boot the unit and enumerate devices on I2C, UART and CAN.

tests.name: battery_rest_check
tests.description: Read pack and per-cell voltages at rest.

tests.name: esc_telemetry
tests.description: Read ESC telemetry: sync errors, packet loss, back-EMF detection.

tests.name: compass_static
tests.description: Compare compass heading to the fixture reference with motors off.

tests.name: harness_continuity
tests.description: Measure per-bus continuity resistance and CAN termination.

tests.name: camera_selftest
tests.description: Run camera built-in self test and measure frame rate and CSI errors.

tests.name: imu_static
tests.description: Log 1000 IMU samples on the static fixture: gyro bias, accel noise, dropouts.

tests.name: motor_spin_test
tests.description: Spin all motors at 50 percent throttle: current, RPM, RPM jitter, temp.

tests.name: compass_motor_interference
tests.description: Sweep throttle 0-75 percent and log compass heading deviation.

tests.name: battery_load_test
tests.description: Apply a 20 A load and measure sag, cell imbalance, internal resistance.

steps.thought: I will run the power_on_selftest to boot the unit and enumerate all communication buses and devices across the subsystems.
steps.observation: The initial power_on_selftest passed successfully with all 4 CAN nodes, UART devices, camera sensor, and I2C devices recognized correctly. No definitive failures are present yet across system startup.

hypotheses.rationale: Initial power on selftest passed cleanly with no errors.
More tests across different subsystems are needed to rule out latent faults.

steps.thought: I will run the battery_rest_check to verify cell voltages at rest, which is a cheap and quick test to check the battery subsystem.
steps.observation: battery_rest_check failed with a cell imbalance of 0.080 V, exceeding the 0.030 V limit. This points toward a weak cell or degraded battery pack.

hypotheses.rationale: Cell imbalance at rest exceeds the maximum allowed limit.
High internal resistance could also contribute to cell voltage discrepancies under rest and load.

steps.thought: I will run the battery_load_test to measure internal resistance and cell sag under load, which will confirm whether the weak cell is severely degraded and distinguish between BATTERY_WEAK_CELL and BATTERY_HIGH_IR.
steps.observation: The battery load test and rest check both showed significant cell imbalance (0.080V at rest and 0.410V loaded) with cell 3 dropping notably lower than the others under load, confirming a weak battery cell.

hypotheses.rationale: Severe rest and loaded cell voltage imbalance clearly points to a weak individual cell in the pack.
High internal resistance was measured at 52.4 mohm, but the isolated drop in a single cell points more directly to a weak cell.

steps.thought: The battery cell imbalance is confirmed across both rest and load tests, identifying a weak cell. Proceeding directly to propose the rework action.
steps.observation: Rework applied; full suite passed: True.
